program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (border-cells r0 c0 r1 c1)
      (append (for/list ([c (in-range c0 (+ c1 1))]) (list r0 c))
              (for/list ([c (in-range c0 (+ c1 1))]) (list r1 c))
              (for/list ([r (in-range (+ r0 1) r1)]) (list r c0))
              (for/list ([r (in-range (+ r0 1) r1)]) (list r c1))))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([color (in-list (grid-colors g 0))])
      (let ((pts (find-color g color)))
        (if (= (length pts) 4)
            (let* ((rs (remove-duplicates (sort (map first pts) <)))
                   (cs (remove-duplicates (sort (map second pts) <)))
                   (corners (if (and (= (length rs) 2) (= (length cs) 2))
                                (list (list (first rs) (first cs))
                                      (list (first rs) (second cs))
                                      (list (second rs) (first cs))
                                      (list (second rs) (second cs)))
                                (list))))
              (if (and (= (length rs) 2) (= (length cs) 2)
                       (all? (lambda (p) (member p corners)) pts))
                  (paint-cells out (border-cells (first rs) (first cs) (second rs) (second cs)) color)
                  out))
            out)))))
